senses.example: Por la tarde vamos al parque.
senses.exampleGloss: In the afternoon we go to the park.

alternatives.reason: The later part of the day, once it gets dark.
The middle of the day, around two in Spain.
The end of the afternoon, when the sun goes down.

notes: Por la tarde is the fixed Peninsular phrase; as an adverb tarde means late (llego tarde).
